these_notes: JSON has no comments. Keys starting with _ are notes by convention, and the
updater reads only 'pi4' and 'zero', so everything here is ignored by devices.
what_this_file_does: Decides what every device runs. Publishing a release does not roll it out;
editing this file does. Set a version back and that fleet rolls back on its
next 02:00 check. A device with PIN set in its own update.conf ignores this.
always_protected: Not something you set - it is the updater's own list, hard-coded in
config/scripts/check_updates.sh and shown here for reference. No release can
replace these paths; only 'include' can claim one, and the device logs it:
keyed_by_hardware_not_version: 'exclude' and 'include' keep applying to every later release until someone
removes them - nothing will remind you. Take an entry out once the rollout
it was added for is superseded.

version: The version to install, or "" for none yet.
Devices move down to reach it as readily as up.
exclude: Paths this hardware keeps, on top of always_protected.
Can only ever protect more, never less.
include: Paths this hardware takes, on top of what the release ships - and the only
way to claim one of the always_protected paths. The release must still
contain the file. A forced path is added to or replaced, never deleted.
